items:
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.

Wear safety 
 helmet, safety shoes.
The equipment must be fully isolated mechanically and electrically.
Empty the pump completely.
Complete tool set.
Lifting ropes, Wooden blocks.
Cleaning fluids, Dial indicator.
Filler gauge, Rages.
Straight edge.
Remove the motor together with the semi coupling.
Remove the semi coupling from motor.
Extract the other semi coupling and V- ring.
Unscrew adjusting ring nut and remove washer.

Remove the oil distribution plate and oil beater plate thus freeing the 
 bearings.
Remove the space coupling and lantern.

Unscrew the nut and remove the gland and extract the packing and unscrew the 
 packing sleeve from the shaft.
Disconnect all main and auxiliary connection pipes.
Unscrew the nut of baseplate and extract the pump from the tank.
Set the pump on wooden supports on the floor.
Remove the lubricator pipe.
Unscrew the nuts and extract the suction body.
Extract the impeller and diffuses and intermediate body and the sleeve.
Continue until the complete disassembly of the pump.
Reassembly by performing the above reverse order.
Check clearance of impeller.
Check the condition of slide bearings.
Check the condition of shafts.
Check the condition of thrust bearing.

Introduction
This document lists the minor maintenance 
procedure P1, 
which must be performed every four years or 40.000 operation hours bases as indicated in the title block

Work to be Carried Out
Disassembly

Extract the other semi coupling and V- ring.
Unscrew adjusting ring nut and remove washer.
Remove the oil distribution plate and oil beater plate thus freeing the 
 bearings.
Remove the space coupling and lantern.

 packing sleeve from the shaft.
Disconnect all main and auxiliary connection pipes.
Unscrew the nut of baseplate and extract the pump from the tank.
Set the pump on wooden supports on the floor.
Remove the lubricator pipe.
Unscrew the nuts and extract the suction body.
Extract the impeller and diffuses and intermediate body and the sleeve.
Continue until the complete disassembly of the pump.
